title: AWS Cloud & DevOps Services

listing.shortDescription: AWS Cloud & DevOps services — secure accounts, automated deployments, observability & cost controls for AI workloads. Free infra review.
listing.fullDescription: AWS is powerful, but it gets expensive and fragile when accounts, networking, permissions and deployments grow without a plan. We set up production-ready AWS foundations: secure accounts, least-privilege IAM, repeatable infrastructure, automated deployments, observability, backups and cost controls. The goal is simple: your product runs reliably, scales when needed and stays maintainable for the team who owns it.

deliverables.title: AWS account and security foundation
deliverables.description: Account structure, IAM roles, least-privilege access, secrets handling and baseline security controls.

deliverables.title: Application infrastructure
deliverables.description: EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront and networking selected around the workload instead of overbuilding.

deliverables.title: CI/CD and release automation
deliverables.description: Automated builds, deployments, environment variables, rollback paths and repeatable release steps.

deliverables.title: Monitoring and cost control
deliverables.description: CloudWatch dashboards, alerts, logs, backups and budget visibility so issues are caught early.

useCases: Deploying a Next.js, API or SaaS product on AWS
Moving a prototype into a secure production environment
Setting up Lambda jobs, queues, storage and managed databases
Improving reliability, monitoring and AWS monthly cost visibility

faq.question: Which AWS services do you set up?
faq.answer: We commonly set up EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, ECS, CloudFront, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch and related networking. The final architecture depends on the product, traffic pattern, budget and team.

faq.question: Can you deploy existing apps to AWS?
faq.answer: Yes. We can review the current app, containerise it where useful, create the AWS infrastructure, configure CI/CD and migrate it with a rollback plan.

faq.question: Do you help reduce AWS costs?
faq.answer: Yes. We look for oversized compute, unused resources, storage lifecycle gaps, missing budgets and architecture choices that are more expensive than the workload needs.

faq.question: How long does it take to set up production AWS infrastructure?
faq.answer: A solid production foundation — secure accounts, networking, CI/CD, observability, and backups — typically takes two to four weeks. Migrating existing workloads adds time depending on how tangled the current setup is.

faq.question: Do you support AI workloads on AWS?
faq.answer: Yes. We design infrastructure for GPU instances, model serving, and the bursty traffic patterns AI products create — with cost controls, because AI workloads are where AWS bills go to explode.

faq.question: Will you document everything and hand it over?
faq.answer: Always. Infrastructure as code, runbooks, and architecture diagrams are deliverables, not extras. Your team should be able to operate everything without us — though most clients keep us around for the hard parts.
